Chapter 6715: I Don’T Have To Do It

Chapter 6715: I Don’t Have To Do It

“Xian Chengtian!” Others shouted his name.

“Wasn’t he dead already? What kind of sorcery is this?” Another said.

“To revive from the dead, it doesn’t make any sense.” A big shot shuddered.

They witnessed his death by the ghost not long ago. Now, he revived somehow from his killer’s corpse.

“So he’s been hiding in there.” A heaven-slayer said.

“Is it possible to hide undetected?” A primal ancestor asked.

“An insane technique.” A supreme overlord said. Xian Chengtian snuck into the ghost’s body during his moment of death.

How could the ghost not detect him, especially after devouring Evil Transformation’s flesh? The ghost had no idea someone was hiding within him all this time.

“Sacred Teacher.” Xian Chengtian bowed.

How he appeared again was sinister. However, spectators remained captivated by his special appearance. His aura still surpassed the ghost in his immortal state. No one could have this effect after coming out of a corpse.

“How shameful, using your masters’ supreme technique in this manner, hiding in another’s mind.” Li Qiye said.

He smiled awkwardly for a second before answering: “Indeed, a waste of their technique. They created it so that I can hide in the primordial tree. It’s just that I had to use it to stay alive.”

The three primordial immortals created this art, hoping he could hide in the primordial tree. However, it became a pivotal part of his overarching plan.

“Can’t carve rotten wood, your talent is wasted.” Li Qiye shook his head.

“I agree. If I had chosen to hide and cultivate within the tree, I would have become an immortal. It’s just that I didn’t want to suffer the process of the dao.” He smiled.

“That’s fine, but other things are unforgivable.” Li Qiye said.

“My lack of filial piety is unforgivable indeed but I have no regrets. I would make the same choice again because why suffer needlessly?” He said.

“Killing you is not enough.” Li Qiye said.

“My crime is worthy of death in any world or epoch, I just don’t want to die yet.” He admitted his sin publicly.

The crowd appreciated his candor. Although he was a bastard, at least he didn’t deny it.

“Still?” Li Qiye smiled.

“We had an agreement, Sacred Teacher, that if I last until the end, not only will you forgive me, you will also help me become an immortal.” He said.

All eyes were on him upon hearing this. If this were true, he would be the true victor and rewarded despite his sins.

“Mmm, I did accept it.” Li Qiye nodded.

“Thank you, Sacred Teacher. I appreciate your rewards.” He bowed and said.

“Stop, you have to survive first.” Li Qiye shook his head.

“Sacred Teacher?” He was surprised to hear this: “You still want to kill me?”

Of course, he knew Li Qiye didn’t have to do it himself. Desolate Ancestor was available right now.

“I won’t be the one to punish you for your sins.” Li Qiye smiled.
